The issuer exhibits a strong financial profile characterized by high profitability (operating margin of 15% and net income of 334M) and a very robust capital structure, with shareholders' equity of 3,064M representing over 60% of total assets. Liquidity is also highly favorable, as evidenced by a solid current ratio of 2.48 and conservative leverage with total liabilities of 1,872M against assets of 4,936M. These strong credit metrics and comfortable buffers justify an upper-medium grade investment rating.

DECISION: A+
